q: Each functional group has a characteristic absorption range of ____. (2024)
e: Infrared spectroscopy uses wavenumbers to identify characteristic absorption ranges of specific functional groups.

q: A large protein molecule is one of the types of ____. (2025)
e: Proteins are naturally occurring polyamides made from amino acid monomer units.

q: Methoxyethane is a colourless ____ at room temperature. (2026)
e: Lower molar mass ethers such as methoxyethane exist as colourless gases at room temperature.

q: Polymers are either found in nature or produced in a ____. (2024)
e: Polymers are classified as either natural polymers found in nature or synthetic polymers produced in a laboratory.

q: Terylene is resistant to ____ and shrinking. (2025)
e: Terylene is a durable synthetic polyester fiber known for resisting stretching and shrinking.

q: The addition of water to propyne in the presence of H2SO4 and HgSO4 at 60°C produces ____. (2026)
e: Hydration of propyne yields an enol intermediate that tautomerizes to propanone.

q: Aldehydes are easily reduced to the ____ alcohols by using LiAlH4 in dry ether at room temperature. (2024)
e: Reduction of aldehydes using reducing agents like LiAlH4 yields primary alcohols.

q: Spectroscopy is the study of the interaction of matter and ____ radiation. (2025)
e: Spectroscopy measures how matter absorbs, emits, or scatters electromagnetic radiation.

q: Ethanol is oxidised by atmospheric oxygen in the presence of ____. (2025)
e: Bacterial action oxidizes ethanol into ethanoic acid in the presence of atmospheric oxygen.

q: At low temperature, addition polymers lose plasticity and elasticity and become ____. (2024)
e: At low temperatures, addition polymers lose their flexibility and become brittle.

q: Terylene and teflon are ____ polymers. (2025)
e: Terylene and teflon are man-made synthetic polymers.

q: ____ in the infrared radiation region can cause bond vibrations in molecules. (2025)
e: Photons in the infrared region carry energy that induces vibrational transitions in chemical bonds.

q: ____ is used for the manufacturing of high-density polyethene in industries. (2025)
e: Ethene monomer is polymerized under specific conditions to produce high-density polyethene.

q: The characteristic odour of cherries is due to ____. (2026)
e: Benzaldehyde is an aromatic aldehyde responsible for the characteristic odour of cherries and almonds.

q: Bending is a vibration that occurs between two bonds and changes the ____. (2025)
e: Bending vibrations involve a change in the bond angle between two chemical bonds.

q: The OH bond of ____ occurs at the range of 2500-3300 cm^-1 in IR band assignments. (2026)
e: Carboxylic acids display a broad O-H stretching band in the 2500-3300 cm^-1 region due to strong hydrogen bonding.

q: The OH bond of ____ usually has an absorption at the range of 3200-3600 cm^-1 in the IR spectrum. (2024)
e: The broad O-H stretch of alcohols typically absorbs in the range of 3200-3600 cm^-1.

q: A ketone does not give reddish-brown precipitate with ____ solution. (2025)
e: Ketones resist oxidation and do not reduce Fehling's solution to form a reddish-brown precipitate.

q: A polymer which consists of more than one kind of monomers is called a ____. (2025)
e: Polymers made from two or more different monomer species are defined as copolymers.

q: Homonuclear diatomic molecules which have no dipole moments are IR ____. (2025)
e: Molecules with no net change in dipole moment during vibration are IR inactive.

q: ____ plastics are made from monomers derived directly from plant materials. (2024)
e: Biodegradable plastics are derived from biological materials like plants.

q: Photons in the infrared radiation region can cause bond ____ in molecules. (2024)
e: Infrared absorption provides energy that leads to molecular bond vibrations.

q: 40% aqueous solution of methanal is known as ____. (2024)
e: Formalin is the commercial term for a 40% aqueous solution of formaldehyde (methanal).

q: ____ is a vibration that occurs along the bond line and changes the bond length. (2026)
e: Stretching vibrations involve movement along the bond axis, leading to a change in bond length.

q: Aldehydes and ketones have the general formula ____. (2025)
e: Aliphatic aldehydes and ketones share the general molecular formula C_n H_2n O.

q: In IR spectroscopy, light atoms vibrate at ____ frequencies than heavier atoms. (2025)
e: Lighter atomic masses result in higher vibrational frequencies.

q: ____ is a vibration that occurs along the bond line and changes the bond length. (2025)
e: Stretching vibration changes the distance between two bonded atoms along the bond axis.

q: ____ frequencies, large wavenumbers, and short wavelengths are associated with high energies. (2025)
e: Energy is directly proportional to frequency and wavenumber, and inversely proportional to wavelength.

q: Since plastics are non-biodegradable, they cannot be broken down by ____ in the soil. (2025)
e: Non-biodegradable plastics resist natural biological decomposition by microorganisms.

q: Fehling's solution is an ____ solution containing copper (II) ions. (2026)
e: Fehling's solution is an alkaline mixture containing copper(II) ions complexed with tartrate.

q: Aldehydes and ketones differ in their ____ reactions. (2026)
e: Aldehydes are easily oxidized to carboxylic acids, whereas ketones resist oxidation.

q: A chemical test is typically a fast reaction performed in a test tube that gives a visual ____ as evidence for a chemical reaction. (2026)
e: A visual clue like color change or precipitation serves as qualitative evidence for a chemical reaction.

q: IUPAC name of ethyl methyl ketone is ____. (2026)
e: The systematic IUPAC name for ethyl methyl ketone is 2-butanone.

q: Fehling's solution is an alkaline solution containing ____ ions. (2026)
e: Fehling's solution consists of an alkaline copper(II) tartrate complex.
